# TPC-H Q12 — Shipping Modes and Order Priority

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpch
```

> [TPC-H](../../tpc-h.md) benchmark · [all TPC-H queries](index.md)

Effect of shipping modes on order priority

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' OR o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT' AND o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count FROM orders, lineitem WHERE o_orderkey = l_orderkey AND l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP') AND l_commitdate < l_receiptdate AND l_shipdate < l_commitdate AND l_receiptdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) AND l_receiptdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY l_shipmode
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def q12_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """TPC-H Q12: Shipping Modes and Order Priority (Expression Family).

    Determines whether selecting less expensive shipping modes affects
    the priority of orders.
    """
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(12)
    shipmode1 = params["shipmode1"]
    shipmode2 = params["shipmode2"]
    start_date = params["start_date"]
    end_date = params["end_date"]

    return (
        lineitem.filter(
            (col("l_shipmode").is_in([shipmode1, shipmode2]))
            & (col("l_commitdate") < col("l_receiptdate"))
            & (col("l_shipdate") < col("l_commitdate"))
            & (col("l_receiptdate") >= lit(start_date))
            & (col("l_receiptdate") < lit(end_date))
        )
        .join(orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="o_orderkey")
        .group_by("l_shipmode")
        .agg(
            col("o_orderpriority")
            .filter(col("o_orderpriority").is_in(["1-URGENT", "2-HIGH"]))
            .count()
            .alias("high_line_count"),
            col("o_orderpriority")
            .filter(~col("o_orderpriority").is_in(["1-URGENT", "2-HIGH"]))
            .count()
            .alias("low_line_count"),
        )
        .sort("l_shipmode")
    )
```
